typical_steps: Ask for the customer's streaming device
Direct the customer to check local zip code and network availability
Provide instructions on how to switch plans or sign up from an account page or PC/Mac browser
Guide the user to navigate to Browse > Networks > Live on supported devices
Recommend troubleshooting steps such as device or modem reboots and searching for content
info_agent_requests: What happens when you try to access these channels?
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents move the conversation to direct messaging or live chat/phone support when investigating account-specific issues, IP address problems, or when following up on a previously opened support thread.
phrases: Live network coverage is based on your current location
We'd love to help! Please chat with us here
never_promises: No set date yet for upcoming features or content
No definitive timelines for rolling out updates or frame rate improvements
No promises on unsupported devices being added immediately
